guard: space add checks the address, the trust, the broker's enforcement and the credentials before it writes, refuses each failure with its code, keeps the selection, space forget removes only a registration this machine owns and is not running, and up refuses a runtime with no installed provider before it writes
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/space-registration.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one check space add, space forget or up makes before it writes, or one code a refusal carries. The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: a --server space is added without checking its broker
mutations.expectRed: a broker that does not answer is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, exit 2
mutations.cell: a broker that does not answer is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, exit 2

mutations.name: the broker's enforcement is not compared with the mode
mutations.find: take(checkEnforcement(mode, await probeEnforcement(server), server, name, root), target);
mutations.expectRed: an open claim on a broker that requires auth is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: an open claim on a broker that requires auth is CONFLICT

mutations.name: a registered name is replaced without --force

mutations.cell: adding a registered name is CONFLICT, exit 2, naming forget and --force

mutations.name: --force replaces a space this machine started

mutations.cell: --force does not replace a space this machine started

mutations.name: a refusal loses the rule's code

mutations.expectRed: a broker that does not answer is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, exit 2
mutations.cell: a broker that does not answer is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, exit 2
